_comment: The file-plan graph. Slots are resolved in order; each names the fragments that compose it and the condition under which it is emitted. integration-builder reads this instead of carrying the plan in prose.
name: default
description: Standard vertical integration: checkout, notification handling, persistence, self-service and audit trail.
order_rationale: Order is load-bearing because of validator dependencies: .gitignore must cover .env before any env file is written (Rule 2), and the webhook handler must exist before the checkout route so the raw-body and signature checks see a complete file.

slots.purpose: Ensure .env is ignored before any env file exists (Rule 2)
Document every credential the provider needs, test-mode values only (Rule 8)
SDK or thin REST client, with the API version pinned
Map provider error codes onto the cross-provider taxonomy

slots.note: The fragment set is chosen by the provider's verification_family and notification_model, NOT by its name. That is what makes a new provider cost one data entry.

slots.purpose: Commit the transaction on return — an uncommitted one auto-reverses
Customer self-service: view, change and cancel the subscription

slots.note: On A2A rails 'refund the charge' does not exist. Emitting a refund endpoint there is fiction — emit the payout-based alternative and say so.

slots.purpose: The e-invoicing obligation attached to the sale in this market
slots.skip_if: region has no tax.einvoice.mandate OR provider.mor.is_mor == true

slots.purpose: What was generated, which events are routed, what is still TODO
